# Product-Scope Owner Disposition

Decision: `SCI-NOI-OWNER-Q-SCOPE-01`.

Owner source: `SCI-NOI_OWNER_DECISION_SUPPLEMENT v0.1/r0.3`, SHA-256
`4b622de96e72860e544bf3699e3a131bc9cca5d2be0b0fe5bb41096327e977e5`.

Approval state: approved.

Base v0.1 produces one independent observation-level NOI ensemble per exact
observation and TolTEC array. It defines no cross-observation randomized
ensemble, randomized coadd, or multi-observation GEN route.

Any future route requires a separate method identity, parent, observation
assignment law, coadd operator, coefficient, response, covariance, atomicity,
and lifecycle contract.
